title: UPDATE: Shooter in Officer Ambush Believed to Be Same Gunman in Waymo Vehicle Attack - NewsBreak
text: UPDATE: A gunman who shot and injured a Santa Monica police officer near the Santa Monica Place Mall Wednesday afternoon is believed to be the same suspect who opened fire on a driverless Waymo vehicle days earlier, injuring two juveniles, authorities said. Santa Monica police issued an alert just before 1:30 p.m. urging the public to avoid the area near Fourth Street and Colorado Avenue. The officer, whose name has not been released, was taken to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Police described the suspect as a Black male in his 30s, last seen wearing a dark-colored jacket and black pants. A photo of the suspect has been shared by the Santa Monica Police Department on its official social media channels. While the immediate area around Santa Monica Place was cleared around 2:30 p.m. and shelter-in-place orders were lifted, a coordinated search effort remains underway. Officers from Santa Monica, Los Angeles, and El Segundo were seen canvassing surrounding streets, assisted by at least one K-9 unit. In a televised interview with KTLA5, Santa Monica Mayor Lana Negrete said investigators believe the same individual is responsible for both Wednesday's shooting and a separate incident Sunday night near Second Street and Broadway. In that case, a shooter opened fire on a Waymo autonomous vehicle, injuring two juveniles inside. Lt. Lewis Gilmour of the Santa Monica Police Department said that shooting stemmed from a verbal altercation between the suspect and the victims. Negrete addressed public concerns earlier in the day as local parents scrambled for updates amid lockdowns affecting schools, summer camps, and youth sports activities. "I understand many parents are concerned," she said. "Please practice caution by staying indoors and avoiding downtown. We're working with all partners to ensure the safety of schools, parks, businesses, and anyone in the area." The Santa Monica Police Department said the investigation is ongoing and updates will be issued through official channels.
